item.title: [Unsupervised Learning] Ep 98: China Expert on Jensen’s Return
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:34 It's been a wild past few weeks in AI world with Jensen Huang out and now back in at NVIDIA. And there's been so many twists and turns to this story. I really wanted to dig into it on the podcast, an emergency episode with a good friend of the pod and personal friend Jordan Schneider from China Talk. Jordan is the perfect person to talk about the geopolitical angles of what happened here, what was behind Jensen getting fired in the first place, and who was behind that, ...
